title: The Regiment of Nagasaki's harbor
author: Marguerite Halloran
blurb: Juniper Brightwater, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the census taker asks one question too many, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
